tei:div.tei:p: rang bzhin gdod nas dag pa'i nam mkha' la/ /sems nyid rgyal po 'gyur med lhun gyis grub/ /rang gsal rigs lnga'i pho brang rang shar ba'i/ / thugs rje phyogs bcur 'phro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang 'dir snying gi 'od kyi phung po yi/ /rang gsal de nas sgrib bral gdod ma'i ngang*/ /'gro rnams yid la snang bar byed don du/ /dbang gi chu bo bzhi las spros med brjod/ /dag pa'i sems la rang gsal bum pa'i sku/ /gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rnam pa gsum/ /rang babs gnas la brda yis 'dir bstan phyir/ /bum pa bsnol ma'i thig 'di gsal bar bya/ /gru bzhi pa ni cha bzhir bgo /nang gi cha gnyis bum pa'i lto/ /gsum pa phyed gong phyi thig gis/ /g.yas g.yon lto ba'i bzhi cha re/ /mtshan ma byas la gyen thur gdab/ /de yang phyed du bgos pa yi/ /shar dang lho gnyis bum pa'i gsham/ /nub dang byang gnyis kha yin te/ /logs zur gang rung rtse nas bskor/ /logs nas bskor na bzhi pa yi/ /shar lho'i phyed la bum gdan bya/ /nub byang sgang po kha brgyan bri/ /zur nas bskor na shar dang lho'i/ /bzhi pa ril po bum pa'i gdan/ /nub dang byang gi bzhi pa nas/ /zlum skor bar du dpag bsam shing*/ /lo 'dab ljang la snying po dmar/ /'bras bu ser po bri bar bya/ /bum pa dmar po 'od lngas bskor/ /bum gdan sna tshogs pad+ma sta ེ / /bar khyams stong gsal nam mkha'i mdog /phyi rim 'od lnga'i rwa bas bskor/ /de yang nang nas rim pa bzhin/ /dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu 'o/ /de kun sku gsung thugs dang ni/ /yon tan phrin las rnam lnga'i brda/ /de yi dag pa bstan pa ni/ /phyogs ris rgya chad med pas na/ /yud tsam zlum la brtags na min/ /rang gsal gdangs lngar gnas pas na/ kha dog lnga yi rwa bas bskor/ /snang stong chos sku gzugs sku'i brda/ /blta lugs gnyis kyis bum pa gnyis/ /de la 'dod dgu lhun grub phyir/ /dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan can/

/stong gsal sna tshogs pad+ma'i tshul/ /de kun 'od lngas yongs bskor ba/ /kun kyang gdod nas rigs lnga'i ngang*/ /rang bzhin gnas pa'i brda yin no/ /de 'dra'i rang bzhin bum pa de/ /'gro ba kun la ye nas gnas/ /rang sems 'od mtha' med pa ni/ /sems nyid ka dag chos sku'i ngang*/ /'od gsal gzugs sku'i rang bzhin shar/ /de la sku lnga ye shes lnga/ /rang gdangs kha dog rnam lngar shar/ /de phyir chos sku gzugs sku gnyis/ /gzhi nas rdzogs phyir snang stong phyir/ /gzhi yang bum pa'i brdas bstan no/ /lam yang ka dag lhun grub gnyis/ /gnas phyir de yi rtsal yang gnyis/ /'gyur ba'i sems dang 'byung bzhi'i lus/ gdos bcas yul dang bcas pa 'o/ /de ltar rtsal gnyis sbyar ba'i phyir/ /nyams len khreg chod thod rgal gnyis/ khregs chod cog bzhag rang grol gyis/ /stong pa'i rtsal las 'phros pa yi/ /'gyur ba'i rig pa zad sar skyel/ /thod rgal rang 'od dbyings shar la/ /mi 'gyur mnyam pa'i gzer btab pas/ /lus dang yul gyi gdos bcas nub/ /rang gsal thog ma'i 'od lngar grol/ /zad pa'i sa la grol bar byed/ /de phyir thod rgal khregs chod gnyis/ /snang stong chos sku gzugs sku gnyis/ /nyams su len phyir lam gnyis ni/ /bum pa'i brda yis mdzad pa 'o/ /'bras bu ka dag lhun grub gnyis/ /de yang zad sar grol ba'i ngang*/ /rig pa sngon thog nyid kyi gzhi/ /rang 'od lnga yi gdangs dang bcas/ /rigs lnga'i tshul du lhun gyis grub/ /de yi ngo bo snang tsam nas/ /brjod bral ka dag chen por gnas/ /de yang rang rig 'og min gnas/ /phyogs bcu na med dbus mtha' med/ / stong khams rig pa'i zhing khams na/ /ye shes 'od dang 'od khyim dang*/ /gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs tshul du snang*/ /lhun 'byams sny-ing po rgyal ba'i zhing*/ / rnam dag stug po bkod pa 'o/ /zhing de'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang*/ /mi gsung mi g.yo spros bral dang*/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis rang byung ba'i/

/bstan pa gsang ba cod pan yang*/ /rang babs phyogs bcur rang snang ngo*/ /de ltar sku gsung thugs chen po/ /rang bzhin lhun rdzogs ngang nyid las/ /gdul bya'i 'jig rten gang yod der/ /sprul pa gang 'dul der snang bas/ /'gro ba'i don kun lhun gyis grub/ /brjod bral kun gyi ngo bo nyid/ /chos sku rang bzhin gzugs kyi sku/ /thugs rje de las 'phros pa yis/ /sprul pa rnams te de ltar na/ /'bras bu 'ang chos sku gzugs sku gnyis/ /bum pa'i brda yis bstan pa 'o/ /'di ni byar med klod yangs kyis/ /mchims phu dpal gyi ri la sbyar/ /rdzogs so// //dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (11)bum pa'i brda don/ - PAGE 88- - PAGE 89- -PAGE 87-
